decision_rules: COMPLETE requires exactly 120 cases in exactly 12 strata at 10 per stratum
COMPLETE requires hard exact overlap = 0 and normalized overlap = 0
COMPLETE requires arbitration membership to equal the reviewer disagreement set exactly
COMPLETE requires the span-boundary variation gate to pass for S01, S02, S05 and S06
COMPLETE requires the locked label path to be gitignored and unstageable
COMPLETE requires every path marked private in the builder SECRECY table to be gitignored, and every path marked public to be NOT gitignored
any registered quota shortfall, any overlap hit, or any unresolved label is a FAIL
exclusion_rules: any case whose exact, normalized or numeric-normalized fingerprint collides with a reachable prior corpus
any case duplicating another case in the set on exact or normalized fingerprint
any case at or above masked-template Jaccard 0.85 with a prior case or another case in the set
any empty or whitespace-only output, because it would collide with the parser-v2 development set
inclusion_rules: case must be a hand-authored model-free fixture
case must belong to exactly one registered stratum and subtype slot
case must carry a registered reference answer that is a legal numeric literal
registered correctness must equal the value computed by the frozen correctness rule
every S11 case must carry at least two distinct canonical candidates
every S06 trailing distractor must canonicalise to a value different from the answer

primary_metric.definition: 120 cases across 12 strata at 10 per stratum, all registered quotas satisfied, zero unresolved labels
primary_metric.name: construction_completeness
primary_metric.note: this round measures the instrument, not any parser

research_question: Does a locked, independently curated, never-seen 120-case evaluator set spanning 12 answer-extraction failure strata, constructed in procedural isolation from the parser under test, give a defensible estimate of answer-extraction reliability?
retry_rules: a reviewer file that violates the protocol is returned for correction, never silently repaired by the curator
a case that collides with a prior corpus is rewritten and the whole build is re-run from scratch
the arbiter is never re-run on a row the reviewers agreed on
no retry may relax a registered quota or an overlap gate
scientific_claim_boundary: no parser-v3 evaluation was run in this round and no parser-v3 result exists
nothing here supports any claim about parser-v3 accuracy, parser-v3 versus parser-v2, or remaining headroom
labels are an LLM operational consensus reference, not human ground truth
zero overlap is proven only against reachable corpora; the retired parser-v2 holdout, the parser-v3 adversarial development set and the full historical records were not reachable from this track
isolation from parser-v3 development is procedural and hash-audited, not security-enforced
the set is not yet sealed, so it is not yet a pre-registered holdout

seeds.note: construction is fully deterministic; the only stored entropy is a private salt file generated once and reused so that case ids and label fingerprints are stable across rebuilds

stopping_rules: construction stops when all registered quotas are satisfied and every gate passes
labeling stops when both reviewers have labeled 120/120 and unresolved = 0
arbitration stops when every disagreement row has exactly one arbitrated judgement
the build aborts immediately on any gate failure; gates are not waived
